headline: Fifth Third Announces Acquisition of DTS Connex, Adding Scale, Innovation in Cash Management
summary: CINCINNATI, August 20, 2025--Fifth Third (Nasdaq: FITB) today announced its acquisition of DTS Connex, a leader in cash management software solutions for multi-location businesses such as retailers, restaurants and healthcare providers.
